schedule.reason: No measured implementation/acceptance throughput exists yet, and owner availability is a lower bound rather than a fixed weekly allocation.
schedule.planningRule: Use the eight dependency batches as sequence only. Record actual hours, wait time, defects, and retest time per task. After the first completed engineering batch, prepare rolling ranges with assumptions; do not treat the result as a committed launch date.

effortEstimate.reason: No measured delivery baseline is available; converting task count or the minimum weekly availability into total hours/weeks would invent precision.

riskReserve.approach: Reserve one acceptance-directed correction and same-case retest loop per task gate. Track external reviews as elapsed wait separately from engineering hours. If a task needs another loop, record the cause and revise the next rolling estimate from observed data.

cloudPlanEvidence.interpretation: Console screenshot and user report are evidence of displayed values only; they do not establish a paid order, actual charge, exact entitlement mapping, or expiry date.

budget.budgetRule: The ¥500 monthly ceiling is a limit, not proof that the launch budget is feasible. Keep one-time costs, monthly fixed costs, usage-based costs, personnel cash, and external waiting separate. No purchase or paid-plan change is authorized by this record.

laterAcceptanceOwnership.trigger: Implemented final candidate and available iPhone/Android real-device test setup.
laterAcceptanceOwnership.threshold: At 60 Hz, three rounds per device group, at least 30 measured segments per round, average at least 55 FPS, and no app-attributable stall over 100 ms.
laterAcceptanceOwnership.failureBlocks: SP35 acceptance and any release gate that depends on it; not SP06.

laterAcceptanceOwnership.trigger: Actual interfaces are implemented and the user-approved latency/error budgets are recorded.
laterAcceptanceOwnership.threshold: Measure actual interface groups against the user-confirmed budgets; missing budgets block the affected endpoint acceptance and SP35 signoff.
laterAcceptanceOwnership.failureBlocks: Affected endpoint task and SP35; not SP06.

laterAcceptanceOwnership.threshold: Three rounds for each applicable path, covering weak-network behavior, unknown outcomes, retries, and recovery under the original quality contract.
laterAcceptanceOwnership.failureBlocks: Affected business task and SP35; not SP06.

laterAcceptanceOwnership.trigger: A final product candidate and actual measured memory/resource budget exist.
laterAcceptanceOwnership.threshold: 60 minutes, at least 60 complete mixed cycles, record every 10 minutes; memory/resource budget must be measured and user-confirmed.
laterAcceptanceOwnership.failureBlocks: SP35 acceptance and release gate; not SP06.

laterAcceptanceOwnership.trigger: The actual web admin pages are implemented.
laterAcceptanceOwnership.threshold: Measure implemented web pages under the original quality contract.
laterAcceptanceOwnership.failureBlocks: SP35 acceptance and release gate; not SP06.

laterAcceptanceOwnership.trigger: Formal engineering exists, then the first applicable flows and final candidate are available.
laterAcceptanceOwnership.threshold: SP07 establishes measurement entry; SP15/SP18 record early baseline; SP35 records final candidate evidence.
laterAcceptanceOwnership.failureBlocks: The affected current task or SP35 if its applicable measurement fails; no pre-product performance result is required to close SP06.

laterAcceptanceOwnership.trigger: Before activating a real provider and again at the release gate.
laterAcceptanceOwnership.threshold: All provider admission, credentials, service scope, qualification, dispute, and operational controls are evidenced; unknown items fail the gate.
laterAcceptanceOwnership.failureBlocks: Real provider activation or release of affected services; not SP06 documentation.

downstreamOpenItems: Record measured task hours, external waits, defects, and retest time as engineering tasks execute; form rolling ranges after the first completed engineering batch.
Verify account-specific CloudBase entitlement, actual billing, expiry, and provider quotations before any paid service selection, configuration, or purchase.
Keep E05 open until actual service-provider supply, coverage, and applicable operating admission evidence are verified before affected real-service activation or release.

completion.environment: Windows 11 local documentation and Node.js test review; no CloudBase writes, purchases, or production changes.
